item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a formal nationwide emergency declaration or a single unified “crisis doctrine” document to evaluate. I also did not find strong evidence of sustained, rights-protective protest management outside the August protest wave. Most evidence comes from protest episodes rather than other spontaneous crises, so the finding is strongest for protest/crackdown behavior.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged that many protesters were motivated by legitimate hopes, commiserated with families of those killed, and asked protesters to suspend demonstrations and create room for dialogue. This is the strongest pro-restraint item in the record, though it was paired with threats that the law would catch up with offenders.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.6","3B.3"]},{"title":"Tinubu asks protesters to suspend demonstrations, seeks dialogue","publisher":"TheCable","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/","summary":"The report emphasizes Tinubu’s explicit call for a pause in protests so dialogue could happen. This supports a limited restraint reading, but the ask was reactive and came during a broader crackdown.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"The government said it was open to dialogue as security forces deployed in major cities. This is mixed evidence: a dialogue channel existed, but it was accompanied by coercive mobilization that undercut restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.6","3B.5"]},{"title":"President Tinubu calls for suspension of sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu urged ECOWAS to choose “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance, rather than treating the bloc or junta-led states as enemies. This is a positive de-escalatory signal, though it concerns regional crisis management more than domestic flare-ups.","question_ids":["3B.9","2B.10"]},{"title":"Tinubu ordered expeditious processing of welfare benefits, demands monthly KPI reports","publisher":"State House","date":"February 22, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-directs-expeditious-processing-of-welfare-benefits-demands-monthly-kpi-reports/","summary":"Tinubu directed faster handling of welfare benefits and said delays to support for vulnerable citizens would not be tolerated. This is protective in a broad crisis-management sense, but it is indirect evidence for this lens.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.7"]},{"title":"Tinubu launches national resettlement scheme for conflict victims","publisher":"State House","date":"July 6, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-launches-national-resettlement-scheme-for-conflict-victims/","summary":"Tinubu launched a resettlement scheme for conflict victims and framed it as rehabilitation and reintegration. This is real positive evidence for non-punitive crisis response, especially for displaced people.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.7","2B.10"]},{"title":"Nigerian police teargas protesters, arrest dozens","publisher":"Reuters via VOA","date":"August 3, 2024","url":"https://www.voanews.com/amp/nigerian-police-teargas-protesters-arrest-dozens/7728731.html","summary":"Police arrested dozens, fired tear gas, and tried to confine protesters to the outskirts of major cities; Reuters also reported nearly 700 arrests in the first three days. This is strong evidence of coercive containment rather than restrained crisis handling.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges 76, including minors, with treason after August protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 1, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nigeria-charges-76-including-minors-with-treason-after-august-protests-3698000","summary":"The government expanded treason charges to 76 people, including 30 minors, after the protests. That is strong evidence of collective punishment and punitive control after a spontaneous flare-up.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Prosecutors alleged that protesters sought to destabilize Nigeria and incite mutiny. This reframed protest as a security threat and helped justify repression rather than restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria police used excessive force to violently quash #Endbadgovernance protests","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"November 28, 2024","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/11/nigeria-police-used-excessive-force-to-violently-quash-endbadgovernance-protests/","summary":"Amnesty reported live ammunition, killings, mass detentions, and torture during the August protests, and said authorities denied wrongdoing. This is the clearest negative evidence that the state response increased fear rather than suppressing violence with restraint.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.2"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters charged with treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW said protesters, including children, were held for long periods with due-process concerns. This is further evidence that the government responded with punitive legal escalation, not protection.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.1"]},{"title":"Nigeria’s police chief warns against “Kenyan-style” protests","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-s-police-chief-warns-against-Kenyan-style-protests-47446946/","summary":"The police chief framed upcoming protests as a threat before they started. This is indirect but relevant evidence of a fear-amplifying posture that likely chilled protest space.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.6"]},{"title":"Nigeria considers tough penalties for subversive acts under proposed law","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"August 14, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/nigeria-considers-tough-penalties-for-subversive-acts-under-proposed-law-3571782","summary":"Reuters reported a proposed Counter Subversion Bill that critics said was aimed at cracking down on dissent after the protests. Even though it was later withdrawn, the proposal itself fits a broader pattern of punitive crisis politics.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.8","3B.5","3B.6"]},{"title":"President Tinubu says government will “come down heavily” on attackers","publisher":"State House","date":"June 2, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-statement-on-the-killings-of-soldiers-in-aba/","summary":"Tinubu said the government would “come down heavily” and could “crush” violent non-state actors. This is understandable after attacks on soldiers, but it is still coercive rhetoric and contributes to a hard-security climate.","question_ids":["3B.9","3B.6","3B.5","3B.1"]}]}
